politicianName: COLLANTES, KING GEORGE LEANDRO ANTONIO V.
profileLabel: Center-left economics (low-medium confidence); mixed on elections
summary: Batangas 3rd District representative with 187 principal-authored bills. Authored taxpayer rights, plastic-bag excise, solar incentives, front-of-package warnings, an anti-dynasty ban, a reset of the 2026 barangay and SK elections, higher campaign spending limits and candidate-substitution changes. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Anti-dynasty and the election reset offset each other; the democratic 0 reflects that conflict, not missing data. Campaign-expense direction judged mildly negative.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Taxpayer-rights charter and solar incentives (+1) with a plastic-bag excise (-1) average to 0 on tax; front-of-package warnings (-2) and co-authored minimum wage (-2) lean left.
